item.coloph: snyigs ma'i kho bo byang chub rdo rje'i rtsal gyis me mo lug gi lo lug gis (gi) zla tshes la/ gyim shod shel brag rdzongs (rdzong) drug seng ge g.yu rdzong nas gter nas drangs te/ slar lcags pho khyi yi lor shar rgyal mo rong gi nye ba'i g.yung drung dpal gyi gdan sar bkra shis smin grol gling gnas lugs 'od gsal gzugs (gnyug) ma'i ngang las shog ser las zhal bshus grub pa'o//
